footprint.method: all URDF visual geometry (joints = 0) projected onto the floor of frame 'base_link' at 1 mm, outer contour, simplified by 1 mm (hm3d robots import-urdf)

limits.v_min.method: The manufacturer only publishes the maximum speed; the maximum reverse speed is assumed equal to it.

limits.vy_max.note: Dingo-D: differential drive (Dingo-O is the omnidirectional version)

limits.w_max.method: The manufacturer does not publish the maximum angular velocity; a conservative 1.0 rad/s is used, in line with TurtleBot3 Waffle Pi (1.82) and TurtleBot 4 (1.90). The kinematic bound 2*v_max/track width is not used because it far exceeds the practical safe limit.

lidar.method: The robot ships without a LiDAR (the manual lists only battery status, wheel odometry, motor currents and an IMU); the common 2D LiDAR RPLIDAR A1M8 is assumed (0.15-12 m, 360 degrees per the SLAMTEC datasheet).

lidar.beams.method: 1 beam per degree, close to the ~1 degree angular resolution of low-cost 2D LiDARs; the environment resamples to n_beams beams.

footprint_simple.note: Dingo-D: 551 x 517 x 110 mm (Dingo-O: 686 x 517 x 114 mm)
